analysis.narrativeEn:

· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.6718 → -0.2003): improving but still negative, maintaining bearish convergence
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $130.25): approaching lower band, with a band width of 29.51% indicating increased volatility

· Swing resistance level ($158.58): below 5-day high and Pivot R1 ($166.66)
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: 5-day low ($136.16) > 20-day low ($130.75) suggests potential for a Higher Low, but 5-day high ($157.63) < 20-day high ($174.64) also observed, indicating trend reversal uncertainty
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.63x): below 5-day average, reducing conviction in price movements
· Current phase diagnosis: oversold territory reached during a downtrend, short-term bounce possible but cautious observation needed due to lack of volume
